tasks.title: Establish isolated product repository, traceable requirements, specialist workflow and reproducible local tooling
acceptance_criteria: Separate local Git repository exists without remote creation; DB-Research inputs and pre-existing status are preserved.
All required design, roadmap, contract, backlog, acceptance, evidence-reference and license inputs retain exact-byte provenance.
All 220 stable feature IDs, 64 original tasks and 63 case contracts retain traceability and distinct product implementation states.
Six specialist TOML definitions parse, inherit model/provider settings, and document actual native delegation and permission limits.
Dependency, ownership, acceptance coverage, evidence hashes, result-cell and current-phase guards pass positive and negative regression tests.
Source build checks, lint, JSON formatting and all available offline tests pass using documented commands.
Initial CI uses pinned tools and read-only repository permissions; no deployment or publishing actions exist.
Decision log, milestone, evidence index, current session state and next bounded tasks are persisted.
Product license and name remain explicitly provisional; no restricted source, assets or Oracle execution is introduced.

tasks.title: Preflight isolated harness workspace and lab input manifest
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible preflight report names every required input and exact missing prerequisite; existing POCs remain protected.
tasks.verification_scope: Offline task increment only; shared WP0-10-01 dependency/license case not accepted.

tasks.title: Audit and pin the candidate driver/parser dependency closure
acceptance_criteria: An auditable candidate lock/notice register and parser isolation feasibility decision exist; unknown required rights block build selection.
tasks.verification_scope: Audited candidate dependency/register and driver-free isolation task increment; no product/distribution/accepted parser approval.

tasks.title: Build mature parser helper and byte-range corpus
acceptance_criteria: Approved parser profile passes every pure parser case and emits reproducible original/source-derived execution bytes; unsupported boundary produces a STOP report.
tasks.verification_scope: Accepted offline parser/byte-range task increment only; Oracle G2, WP0-T08, distribution and product features are not verified.

tasks.title: Implement Thin connectivity and fault-proxy probes
acceptance_criteria: Connectivity/grant/timeout/secret observations for both 19c and 21c are recorded separately; missing lab inputs stop dependent runtime probes.
blockers: No explicitly authorized disposable Oracle 19c/21c profile, TCPS identities, scoped credential/grant/fault references or teardown authority supplied. Offline Thin import is not connectivity evidence.

offline_increment.acceptance_note: Runtime acceptance and all124Oraclecells remainBLOCKED; offline planning has no criterion coverage or connection authority.

covered_code: Bound admission and atomic one-use claim port contract
Scoped credential revision and approved mTLS wallet validation
One strict Thin TCPS connection and fixed read-only session identity query
Sanitized rejection, no fallback/retry, close/HOLD handling
missing_runtime_wiring: Authenticated authority and atomic claim backends
Approved disposable 19c/21c manifests and scoped grants
Approved client wallet/trust and credential providers
Trusted fixed-entry supervised worker deployment with OS isolation and sanitized environment
Independent canonical target/container and session observations
read_only_candidate.acceptance_note: Twenty-one UNIT tests use fake positive connectors and native offline TLS contexts. No complete T04 criterion or Oracle case coverage is claimed; all 124 Oracle cells remain BLOCKED.

supervision_candidate.acceptance_note: Actual Node child processes and fake positive drivers/providers verify watchdog/protocol/reaping mechanics only. Unconfirmed workers remain owned and block replacement. All Oracle cells and T04 acceptance stay BLOCKED.

tasks.title: Probe discovery, alias identity and visibility
acceptance_criteria: Canonical target/visibility findings are reproducible and fail closed on unknown mapping or insufficient grants.

tasks.title: Bootstrap disposable target ledgers and DDL-safe mutex
acceptance_criteria: Actual target grants/lock ownership/DDL commits and receipt barriers are observable; bootstrap cannot touch a non-fixture target.

tasks.title: Implement immutable plan/approval harness model
acceptance_criteria: Pre-checkpoint mutation, actor, expiry/revocation and stale-history negatives reject before migration calls; post-checkpoint revocation retains in-flight effects and blocks later permits. This is a harness model, not certified platform authorization.

tasks.title: Execute Oracle corpus and verify object outcomes
acceptance_criteria: Each required parser/runtime fixture has independent 19c/21c evidence; driver return success cannot hide invalid or unobserved objects.

tasks.title: Demonstrate divergent-history planning and zero-effect rerun
acceptance_criteria: Observed execution counts are A=2/B=4 then both zero; no fake receipt seeding or changed-checksum repair.

tasks.title: Inject concurrency/crash/ledger-reconciliation faults
acceptance_criteria: All mandatory fault cases retain actual observations and block unproven replay; logical rewind is never reported as an actual Oracle restore.

tasks.title: Validate least privilege, secret redaction and offline evidence
acceptance_criteria: All security/license/offline cells pass with evidence or remain explicitly BLOCKED; mandatory dependency rights and secrecy are hard gates.

tasks.title: Review all WP0 gates and record the architecture decision
acceptance_criteria: A signed/reviewed decision says GO only when every mandatory applicable cell passes; otherwise CONDITIONAL GO for further probes or NO-GO with exact blockers.

tasks.title: Create approved independent platform workspace and contract fixtures
acceptance_criteria: Approved workspace builds its empty API/worker/domain packages and contract fixtures; no production deployment.

tasks.title: Implement organization/project/environment and immutable identity metadata
acceptance_criteria: Cross-org FK and invalid archive negatives fail transactionally; seeded fixture organizations/projects/environments remain isolated.

tasks.title: Implement durable audit and content-addressed artifact primitives
acceptance_criteria: Denied and successful actions retain authenticated actor/resource/time/intent; altered blobs are rejected and worker deletion loses no evidence.

tasks.title: Implement canonical intent and outcome state transitions
acceptance_criteria: Cross-language canonical hashes agree; RETURNED/INVALID and UNKNOWN receipt examples never become VERIFIED_SUCCESS.

tasks.title: Harden metadata constraints and supported upgrade compatibility
acceptance_criteria: Supported metadata upgrades preserve immutable identities and audit/artifacts; incompatible versions fail readiness before claims.

tasks.title: Implement protected connection profiles and credential references
acceptance_criteria: Wrong PDB/trust/scope, user-supplied DSNs and API writer-secret reads fail before migrations.

tasks.title: Implement canonical container/schema/route identities
acceptance_criteria: Same alias target shares mutex identity; other PDB/owner differs; schema labels cannot downgrade an environment.

tasks.title: Implement shallow discovery and visibility reports
acceptance_criteria: Repeated discovery yields two stable application owners; invisible diagnostics do not become VALID or authorize writes.

tasks.title: Implement active schema assignments and shared endpoint references
acceptance_criteria: A metadata fixture with 500 schema references retains shared endpoint rows without duplicate credentials; runtime two-project isolation passes.

tasks.title: Implement topology generation quarantine
acceptance_criteria: Old-generation intent is unusable even when names/DBID match; quarantine is durable and auditable.

tasks.title: Complete estate inventory/admin pagination and revision controls
acceptance_criteria: Core inventory supports representative estate management without alias duplication, unauthorized count disclosure or stale-plan execution.

tasks.title: Expose grouped estate projection data
acceptance_criteria: Grouped estate data is correctly authorized and read-only; no duplicate physical resource model.

tasks.title: Implement protected local Git repository/folder bindings
acceptance_criteria: Only the bound repository/folder can ingest; read failures are sanitized and configuration changes invalidate relevant intents.

tasks.title: Resolve full immutable Git object provenance
acceptance_criteria: A branch move cannot alter retained bytes; ambiguous short IDs fail and unsupported object formats fail explicitly.

tasks.title: Implement folder discovery and deterministic numeric versions
acceptance_criteria: All five fixture migrations ingest together; V001/V1 duplicate fails and V2 precedes V10 with reproducible raw hashes.

tasks.title: Freeze parsed release manifest and retained execution bytes
acceptance_criteria: A malformed later file blocks the entire release before effects; manifest identity changes with execution-affecting content and works while Git is offline.

tasks.title: Implement per-target history snapshots and pending planning
acceptance_criteria: A=1..3/B=1 yields pending 2/4; changed V002 and unobserved history block; zero-pending intent remains reviewable.

tasks.title: Run Core planning/provider/baseline/promotion conformance
acceptance_criteria: Core planning keeps identical source semantics across providers and stages and does not re-run baseline/adopted versions.

tasks.title: Implement minimal named local CLI identities
acceptance_criteria: Unauthenticated/forged/revoked actors cannot read resources or approve; no caller-supplied actor ID becomes trusted.

tasks.title: Implement membership and fixed resource authorization
acceptance_criteria: Direct API, CLI and guessed cross-project IDs fail consistently; revocation denies new actions and requester cannot gain execution permission.

tasks.title: Implement frozen requests and independent approval
acceptance_criteria: Exact SQL/target/options/history are previewable; all mutation/self-approval/expiry negatives deny and decisions remain auditable.

tasks.title: Implement idempotent authorization and durable dispatch admission
acceptance_criteria: Same body/key returns same job; conflicts and revocations block; approver role alone cannot dispatch and worker receives no caller-supplied SQL.
Current-authority mutation and permit commit have an explicit serialized order; revocation never promises an already-permitted Oracle call is recalled.

tasks.title: Complete local identity/session lifecycle for multiple users
acceptance_criteria: Logout, credential/session expiry and removal deny further approval/admission without waiting for a UI refresh.

tasks.title: Implement guided resubmission lineage metadata
acceptance_criteria: Guided resubmission cannot reuse old decisions or erase contributors; history remains immutable.

tasks.title: Implement authorized target identity/history bootstrap and reader
acceptance_criteria: Bootstrap refuses populated unmanaged or wrong-generation targets; local receipt uniqueness is independent of central history.
Observer history reads succeed only within authorized target scope; missing grants block planning, and the API cannot resolve owner/bootstrap credentials.

tasks.title: Implement same-session DDL-safe target mutex
acceptance_criteria: Alias/session contention, DDL commit and paused-lease probes show no concurrent target writes.

tasks.title: Implement job claims and locked dispatch revalidation
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate delivery cannot duplicate SQL; changed snapshot invalidates approval; zero-pending run retains audit and zero-call proof.
Pre-checkpoint revocation denies SQL; post-checkpoint revocation stops future permits and truthfully retains in-flight/unknown effects.

tasks.title: Implement ordered execution and truthful target receipts
acceptance_criteria: Schema/data effects match approved bytes; failures preserve last acknowledged calls and four outcome axes; target receipt cannot precede required file validation.

tasks.title: Implement owner/type validity and independent postchecks
acceptance_criteria: Valid specification/invalid body, missing object and failed postcheck never become VERIFIED_SUCCESS; successful receipts/effects remain truthful.

tasks.title: Implement configurable bounded estate execution budgets
acceptance_criteria: 500 schema metadata entries do not open 500 idle writer sessions; configuration cannot bypass target serialization.

tasks.title: Implement central/target reconciliation decision table
acceptance_criteria: No ledger absence proves no effect; unknown admission prevents replay and missing authorization is never fabricated.

tasks.title: Implement recovery incidents and safe worker drain/restart
acceptance_criteria: Crash, SIGTERM and lease expiry leave honest unresolved state; read-only incident inspection works with protected evidence.

tasks.title: Implement narrow independently approved recovery admission
acceptance_criteria: No automatic or operator reset-to-pending exists; unknown DDL and forged recovery approval cannot run.

tasks.title: Implement explicit baseline and fix-forward/adoption provenance
acceptance_criteria: No ordinary APPLIED fabrication or checksum editing; lower unknown version blocks correction until authorized resolution; baseline/adoption retain different provenance.

tasks.title: Implement generation-fenced backup/restore reconciliation
acceptance_criteria: Both-direction actual restore exercises prove no automatic queued replay; logical rewind tests alone cannot close this production gate.

tasks.title: Expose minimal loopback API and deterministic CLI plan preview
acceptance_criteria: CLI/API expose the same authorized plan and statement digest; approved actor cannot be supplied as an unauthenticated flag.

tasks.title: Expose dispatch/history/compiler/incident/evidence inspection
acceptance_criteria: A user can reconstruct a completed, invalid and ambiguous run from persisted facts; driver success never hides compiler errors.

tasks.title: Verify all sixteen WS outcomes against actual integrated modules
acceptance_criteria: Every WS feature acceptance and sixteen-outcome checklist passes on both versions; harness results do not substitute for this integrated regression.

tasks.title: Add grouped estate, guided resubmission and outcome views
acceptance_criteria: Presentation does not alter approval/admission semantics and omitted views do not block safe core operation.

tasks.title: Integrate Core administrative and operating API contracts
acceptance_criteria: Every applicable Core action and negative cross-project/missing-approval/restore-hold path passes on actual modules.

tasks.title: Integrate self-hosted GitLab immutable provider
acceptance_criteria: Actual GitLab version/API compatibility and branch-move/outage negatives pass; a CI caller cannot approve or obtain writer secrets.

tasks.title: Implement verified DEV/SIT/UAT/PROD promotion
acceptance_criteria: Missing/failed/invalid/unknown UAT blocks PROD admission; no execution against actual production during implementation acceptance.

tasks.title: Package restricted Kubernetes/OpenShift/API TLS deployments
acceptance_criteria: No privileged SCC/external egress needed; API cannot read writer secrets; dependency outage changes readiness without liveness restart loops.

tasks.title: Produce reviewed offline mirror/install/update bundle
acceptance_criteria: Every shipped dependency has provenance/rights/hash; air-gapped install/update succeeds without proprietary required components.

tasks.title: Package standalone offline evidence verification
acceptance_criteria: Authorized recipients can independently validate exported evidence with a reviewed OSS offline tool; no proprietary service dependency.

tasks.title: Provide reproducible local WS process bootstrap
acceptance_criteria: Another developer can reproduce the bounded WS process topology and input checks from a fresh checkout.

tasks.title: Verify secrets-at-rest, egress and identity threat boundaries
acceptance_criteria: All negative permission/secret/transport tests pass and exact remaining risks have explicit operating owners.

tasks.title: Implement supported evidence retention and operational runbooks
acceptance_criteria: Required SQL hashes/decisions/compiler/recovery evidence survives pods, retention operations and restored metadata; no secret backup leakage.

tasks.title: Run 50-service/500-schema/20-user capacity and safety acceptance
acceptance_criteria: Documented required capacity and agreed p95/session budgets pass with actual target workload evidence; synthetic metadata alone cannot certify estate execution scale.

tasks.title: Implement portable joined deployment evidence export
acceptance_criteria: Recipient can match approved bytes to recorded execution/target; modified or missing evidence fails verification and cross-project export is denied.

tasks.title: Review operating gates and publish local production-readiness decision
acceptance_criteria: Production readiness is supported by actual integrated evidence, not research or WP0 alone; explicit deployment authorization remains separate.

tasks.title: Review integrated WS security and evidence exit
acceptance_criteria: All sixteen outcomes and applicable WS invariants have actual module evidence; only named DEV capabilities are accepted.

tasks.title: Deliver runnable local governance workflow
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible local command starts the API, web application, and PostgreSQL-backed metadata store.
Projects, environments, and connection profiles persist; connection secrets never appear in API responses or logs.
A Git migration release can be imported, parsed, validated, and displayed with source references.
The application generates a pending-change plan with approval and rejection transitions and audit history.
Migration history records NOT_EXECUTED when no authorized database execution occurs; no success is fabricated.

tasks.title: Archive projects and reject new work on archived projects
acceptance_criteria: A project can be archived persistently and its archived state is visible in project list and detail responses.
Archived projects reject new environments, connection profiles, Git releases, and migration plans with a stable conflict response.
Existing project details, audit events, and migration history remain readable after archival.

tasks.title: Register local Git repositories for migration imports
acceptance_criteria: The reproducible development CLI uses Node's native parseArgs for one to eight repeatable --repository PATH options, registers existing local Git directories, and displays only repository IDs and names.
Invalid flags, URLs, and non-repository paths are rejected before PostgreSQL or Docker startup with fixed errors that do not disclose supplied paths.

Registration never clones, fetches, or resolves provider credentials; custom releases use the existing parser with an immutable resolved commit, database execution remains NOT_EXECUTED, and no Oracle behavior is claimed.

tasks.title: Bind a registered Git repository and migration folder to projects
acceptance_criteria: A project can persist and display its source binding using an allowlisted repository ID and migration folder; API and web views never expose repository paths or credentials.
Imports reject an unbound project or repository/folder mismatch before Git or parser work begins.
Archived projects reject source-binding changes while existing releases, plans, audit history, and migration history remain readable with execution state NOT_EXECUTED.

tasks.title: Audit authenticated review denials without changing migration plans
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated plan-decision rejections for role, author, and terminal-state conflicts record a fixed denial reason and server actor/resource metadata without changing the plan or migration history.
Malformed and unauthenticated requests cannot persist arbitrary request data; archived projects reject review requests without appending new project audit events.
The web audit view displays denied decisions; existing approval/rejection transitions remain terminal and all migration execution states remain NOT_EXECUTED.
